findings.status: Resolved in6c54f52abdea3f478524bdf9fbeaf3892541dd71; independently reproduced before fix and rechecked after fix
findings.original_sequence: Thread startup fails and queues an error while record state is already failed; immediate retry starts a blocked writer before the GUI polls that old error. Polling the old error marks the live record failed/busy=false, permitting duplicate work or early close.
findings.fix: Each eligible submission increments a per-record attempt. Every work item and result carries its attempt. poll discards stale attempts before changing paths, state or retained points.
findings.independent_fixed_results: With1,2,3 consecutive startup failures followed by retry, busy remained true while the writer was blocked; no stale event was delivered; the row remained retained; extra retry did not queue duplicate work; each run finished exactly1 CSV and2 PNGs, then released points.
findings.retention_and_fallback_review: Current-attempt partial failures still preserve committed CSV/PNG paths and immutable points/target. Retrying missing components and close-cutoff behavior are unchanged. Stale startup errors cannot clear a newer attempt's state or saved paths.
